sources.title: Hugging Face's Clem Delangue: Stop Comparing Engines to Cars
sources.quote_checked: relying on closed APIs and third-party vendors that can dictate terms, raise prices whenever they want | deprecate models whenever they want, or change them behind the scenes | It gives some control back to builders, which is nice.

sources.title: Hugging Face CEO says we're in an "LLM bubble," not an AI bubble
sources.quote_checked: I think we're in an LLM bubble, and I think the LLM bubble might be bursting next year. | 'LLM' is just a subset of AI when it comes to applying AI to biology, chemistry, image, audio, [and] video.

sources.title: Video and transcript: Fireside chat with Clem Delangue, CEO of Hugging Face
sources.quote_checked: the main thing that we're trying to push at Hugging Face is more transparency in terms of how these systems are built | we think every single company or every single team should be able to use open source to train their own models | I wish more startup founders were actually building AI, not just using AI systems | you can't control, improve and align a system that you don't understand | AI is Software 2.0 | there's been more than a million repositories that have been hosted on the hugging face platform | There's over 20,000 open data sets that you can use on the platform. | Over 100,000 demos are hosted on the platform. | more than 15,000 companies are using the platform to bring AI into their features

sources.title: Hugging Face goes from a scrappy startup named after an emoji to $13 billion Nvidia acquisition
Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
sources.quote_checked: it needs more compute, more support, more collaboration, and more visibility | That's why we went to talk to Jensen, who offered to do exactly that with us.
